QUOTE: The one real write is `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords` (`base_data_operator/index.ts:191-211`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says writes go through `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords` and that the base is `ServerDataOperatorBase`. It never says each mixin is constrained to extend `ServerDataOperatorBase`, which is the reason the item requires. It also says not every write goes through `batchRecords`, which contradicts the "every handler" conclusion.
